    23  # Finite-dimensional topological vector spaces over complete fields
    24  
    25  Let `𝕜` be a complete nontrivially normed field, and `E` a topological vector space (TVS) over
    26  `𝕜` (i.e we have `[AddCommGroup E] [Module 𝕜 E] [TopologicalSpace E] [IsTopologicalAddGroup E]`
    27  and `[ContinuousSMul 𝕜 E]`).
    28  
    29  If `E` is finite dimensional and Hausdorff, then all linear maps from `E` to any other TVS are
    30  continuous.
    31  
    32  When `E` is a normed space, this gets us the equivalence of norms in finite dimension.
    33  
    34  ## Main results :
    35  
    36  * `LinearMap.continuous_iff_isClosed_ker` : a linear form is continuous if and only if its kernel
    37    is closed.
    38  * `LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional` : a linear map on a finite-dimensional Hausdorff
    39    space over a complete field is continuous.
    40  
    41  ## TODO
    42  
    43  Generalize more of `Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Module/FiniteDimension.lean` to general TVSs.
    44  
    45  ## Implementation detail
    46  
    47  The main result from which everything follows is the fact that, if `ξ : ι → E` is a finite basis,
    48  then `ξ.equivFun : E →ₗ (ι → 𝕜)` is continuous. However, for technical reasons, it is easier to
    49  prove this when `ι` and `E` live in the same universe. So we start by doing that as a private
    50  lemma, then we deduce `LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional` from it, and then the general
    51  result follows as `continuous_equivFun_basis`.
    52  
    53  -/
